scope: Producer-specific metric I-girders named after the AASHTO/PCI types. Geometry taken only from each Mexican document; not aliases of the US PCI profiles.

dragon.title: Ficha técnica — Trabes tipo AASHTO
dragon.transcription: Read visually from a 400-dpi render; every printed vertical chain sums to the printed depth.
geometry_notes: Sharp-cornered polygons as drawn; no chamfers or fillets are drawn or dimensioned.
Tipo I web printed 0.13 m (drawn 0.132 m at the sheet scale); Tipo V and VI webs printed and drawn 0.26 m. Transcribed as printed; they differ from the US PCI 6 in / 8 in webs.

CONVENTION (Tipo V, VI): the horizontal break point between the 0.08 m outer and 0.10 m inner top tapers is not printed. Scaled from the drawing (half-width 0.231 m for V, 0.229 m for VI against the 1.06 m printed top width), i.e. a 45-degree 0.10 x 0.10 m inner bevel; knee width 0.46 m used.
Tipo I–IV have a single top taper from the flange edge to the web, as drawn.

tubeco.title: Elementos presforzados (brochure)
tubeco.transcription: Read visually from a 400-dpi render of PDF p7. PDF p8 (printed 7) shows a Nebraska girder identical in callouts to SEPSA's (125/127 top, 100/102 base, 10+22, H-74, 27+15, R20, R5) with only an H range 135-240 cm; not implemented separately (corroborates mx.SepsaNebraskaSection).
geometry_notes: Soffit chamfer: printed 2 cm horizontal leg (56 = 2 + 52 + 2 etc.); vertical leg not printed, taken as 2 cm (45 degrees). Area effect 4 cm2.
Top-flange edge corners are drawn slightly rounded but not dimensioned; modelled square.
SOURCE TYPO (Tipo III): overall top width printed '30' but the printed sub-chain is 11 + 18 + 11 = 40 and the drawn width scales to 38.8 cm against the printed 56 cm base. 40 cm used.

SOURCE TYPO (Tipo IV): vertical chain printed 20 + 9 + 57 + 23 + 20 = 129 against printed depth 135. The drawn top taper scales to 15.2 cm (other segments 19.3/56.7/23.7/20.1); 15 cm used, closing the chain at 135. The '9' appears copied from Tipo III.
Tipo V and VI: printed horizontal chain 34 + 9.5 + 20 + 9.5 + 34 = 107 fixes the knee width at 39 cm; chain 13 + 7 + 10 + web + 25 + 20 sums to the printed depth.
